[[File:Steel cannonball detail.png|left|130px]]
'''Steel cannonballs''' are [[ammunition]] used for a [[dwarf multicannon]], as well as for a [[Cannon (facility)|boat cannon]] during [[boat combat]]. They can be fired from [[steel cannon]]s or stronger.

Four can be made from a single [[steel bar]] with level 35 [[Smithing]], granting 25.6 experience per bar. Smithing cannonballs require the use of an [[ammo mould]], which requires partial completion of [[Dwarf Cannon]] to obtain. Alternatively, a [[double ammo mould]] (requiring [[Foundry Reputation]] to purchase via the [[Giants' Foundry]] minigame) allows players to process two bars into eight cannonballs at the same speed as a regular ammo mould processes one bar into four.

Players with level 87 [[Sailing]] can further speed up smithing cannonballs by using the [[ancient furnace]] in the [[Grimstone Dungeon]], which halves the time it takes to create cannonballs from 8 ticks to 4 ticks. Combining this with a double ammo mould, players can smith cannonballs at four times the normal speed.

Lastly, players with level 50 [[Smithing]] can use [[granite dust]] on steel cannonballs to create [[granite cannonball]]s, which gives superior stats on boat cannons, and increases the max hit of dwarf multicannons by 5. This yields no experience.

[[File:Cannonball Smithing.gif|frame|right|A player smithing steel cannonballs.]]
Making steel cannonballs is a popular method for players to train [[Smithing]] and profit without requiring much input or attention. A full inventory takes 160 seconds to process using Make-X. Optimal speeds yield nearly 14,000 Smithing experience per hour from converting a total of 540 [[steel bar]]s into 2,160 cannonballs when using the [[Prifddinas]] furnace. Using a furnace closer to a bank will increase efficiency.

Players can also smelt one [[iron ore]] and two [[coal]] to make the steel bars and then use them to make cannonballs without returning to a bank, but it is very slow. Unless using the [[Blast Furnace]] with a [[coal bag]], the profit gained from creating your own steel bars is far less than using premade steel bars.

The [[double ammo mould]] from [[Giants' Foundry]] almost doubles production and experience rates.

==Trivia==
*Cannonballs had a festive override to look like [[wikipedia:Christmas pudding|christmas pudding]]s during the [[2017 Christmas event/Gallery|2017]], [[2018 Christmas event/Gallery|2018]], and [[2019 Christmas event/Gallery|2019]] Christmas events. The override had a darker colour in 2019 compared to 2017 and 2018.
* Making a cannonball uses the same animation as when a player buries [[bones]].
* This is the tradeable item with the lowest [[Item IDs|Item ID]] in the game (2).
